findings.title: Full-natural visual scenes are not hard-gated to a positive teaching occurrence
findings.required_action: For future regression use, require the expected machine in full_natural and tempo_full_natural, or give those scenes explicit expected-positive/expected-negative status instead of treating any absence as a negative path.
findings.re_review_condition: A probe regression test must fail when the full-natural teaching event is removed, then pass after the positive expectation is enforced; current frozen visual.json does contain one event for each full-natural scene.

findings.title: Visual packet reconciliation covers the frozen evidence shapes but is narrow for broader native packets
findings.required_action: Before reusing the adapter beyond the frozen scenarios, account for legitimate unwrapped native side hits on third agents and native healing when reconciling parent damage to authoritative HP; current frozen directed and full-natural evidence stays within supported packet shapes and all seven visual checks pass.
findings.re_review_condition: Add directed visual cases containing an unwrapped native side-target record and a native heal in the same packet; both must reconcile without weakening teaching ownership checks.
